name: Crispy Tofu Sandwiches with Garlic Aioli & Arugula-Cucumber Salad

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu into ½-inch thick planks along the short side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemons into a small bowl (reserve lemons for the dressing). Add mayo and spices, then stir to combine the aioli.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Place tofu on the baking sheet. Spread 1 tablespoon aioli over top side of the tofu, sprinkle with half of the bread crumbs, and drizzle with half of the oil. Carefully flip tofu and repeat with 1 tablespoon aioli, remaining bread crumbs, and remaining oil. (Reserve remaining aioli for sandwiches.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup panko bread crumbs
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place tofu in the oven and bake, turning once, until the breading is crispy and golden brown, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice the lemons into a large bowl. Add oil, maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and thinly slice cucumbers crosswise into rounds; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Add broccoli slaw and arugula to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
Spread the remaining aioli over both halves of each bun. Layer each with a small portion of salad (reserving the rest for serving) and crispy tofu.
To serve, divide sandwiches and reserved salad between plates. Enjoy!
